arguments.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*), MIN(order_ts), MAX(order_ts), SUM(order_ts LIKE '2025%') FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) shp, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL)) dlv, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id)) pay, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) ref FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), COUNT(s.shipment_id), COUNT(s.delivered_ts) FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), COUNT(r.refund_id) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(status=9)/COUNT(*),2), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_ts LIKE '2025%'
